matched_intervention.historical_gate_parity: Same original stability gate structure and tolerances; R0_ONLY is this intervention matched control. No old trained coordinate outputs are changed.

original_goal.all_three_seeds_joint_gain: DIVERSE251 each seed has smaller natural99 T and R medians than pairedSINGLE251 and fixedR0/PRIOR1/FULL125. No best-seed reporting.
original_goal.joint_uncertainty: For DIVERSE-SINGLE and DIVERSE-R0, paired recording-and-training-seed bootstrap2000/seed20261001 of mean per-seed population medians has upper95% endpoint<0 for BOTH T and R.
original_goal.recording_sensitivity: Leaving out each of6naturalrecordings retains negative mean-seed median differences for BOTH metrics versus R0 and pairedSINGLE.
original_goal.natural_tails: Mean acrossseed P90 T/R no more than5% above R0 and pairedSINGLE. Full pose failure count must not increase.
original_goal.clean_preservation: Mean acrossseed clean29 median and P90 T/R no more than5% aboveR0; pose failure count notincrease.
original_goal.tolerance_status: The5% guards are provisional engineering non-regression limits, not an empirical noise floor/MDE or evidence of statistical equivalence.
original_goal.strong_generalization: Not claimed from reusedDEV,3seeds and6recordings. Independent new-recording confirmation remains a separate evidentiary limitation.
